adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts, the code wraps the token refresh call with refreshOAuthTokens(). When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response object (lines 6-14 of refreshOAuthTokens.ts show 'return response' from fetch). However, the HubSpot code expects a HubspotToken object with specific properties like access_token, refresh_token, expires_in. The code then tries to use hubspotRefreshToken.accessToken and hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn (visible in the original code pattern). This type mismatch means when credential sync is enabled, the HubSpot refresh flow will fail because a Response object doesn't have these token properties.
